speaker: Grace
text: Hey Sam, how did the marathon go on Sunday?

speaker: Sam
text: I finished! Slower than I hoped, but my knees survived.

speaker: Grace
text: Congrats, that's huge. Okay, let's start with feedback from the launch.

speaker: Grace
text: Your incident write-up last week was excellent. The timeline was clear and the follow-ups were concrete.

speaker: Sam
text: Thanks, that took a while. I wasn't sure it was too long.

speaker: Grace
text: It was the right length. One thing to work on: speak up earlier in design reviews when you see a risk, instead of after the meeting.

speaker: Sam
text: Fair. I'll try to raise concerns in the review itself.

speaker: Grace
text: Next topic. We talked about you moving to the platform team. I talked to their lead and it's confirmed: you'll move to the platform team in January.

speaker: Grace
text: Before you go, I'd like a design doc for the caching layer so the current team can carry it on.

speaker: Sam
text: I'll write the caching design doc by next Monday.

speaker: Grace
text: Good. And on my side, I'll approve your conference budget by Friday.

speaker: Sam
text: Thanks. One question I had: does the promotion cycle count work from the fourth quarter, or only up to September?

speaker: Grace
text: Honestly, I don't know yet. HR hasn't published the rules, so let's keep that open.

speaker: Sam
text: Okay. Also, maybe someday I'd like to look into Kotlin for the mobile app, but no rush.

speaker: Grace
text: Let's park that for now, it's not a priority this quarter.
